A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the classification of ships into classes is a difficult task, which requires a combination of several techniques, and that the use of electro-optical sensors is a promising way to obtain the necessary information.
the use of electro optic systems for aided recognition of small vessels can be a useful tool, but the use is limited by the quality of the data and the complexity of the environment.
, for the task of discriminating classes of ships, we found that the best results are obtained when combining information from different electro optical systems.

the use of electro optic systems for aided recognition in coastal environments is feasible.
